title: AWS Service Catalog: approved self-service products

kcs.statement: AWS Service Catalog lets administrators publish portfolios of approved products, each defined by a CloudFormation template, that users can launch themselves.
Service Catalog fits when a company wants employees to launch only pre-approved, compliant configurations without being given broad IAM permissions to the underlying services.

problem_ideas: Data scientists need EC2 GPU instances, but only in two approved sizes with encryption on: which service?
A new hire should launch a standard dev environment in one click without admin rights: design the answer.
What artifact defines a Service Catalog product?
Service Catalog vs AWS Marketplace: an internal catalogue of approved products vs third-party software. Sort five scenarios.
Service Catalog vs Control Tower: which one governs accounts, and which one governs what users can launch?
Distractor drill: 'restrict users to a pre-approved list of IT services' with options IAM, Service Catalog, Organizations, Trusted Advisor.
